summary: The term مَحُونَةٌ (maḥūnah) is defined by referring to the root حين (ḥīn).
lane: مَحُونَةٌ محا محونه محونة (not مُحُونَةٌ ): see art. حين .

headwords.def: A trial, (S, Msb, K,) or trying affliction: (S:) pl. مِحَنٌ. (Msb.)
مَحُونَةٌ محا محونه محونة (not مُحُونَةٌ ): see art. حين.

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
